title: Clo In Madrid: User Summit 2024 Highlights
description:
The Madrid User Summit was electric! ⚡We were thrilled to see both long-term users and many new faces, with a remarkable 60% increase in attendees this year. This growth mirrors our rapid expansion in Spain, highlighted by the presence of so many incredible brands like MANGO, Gobik, SPRINTER, Bershka, PULL&BEAR, and ZARA.

A heartfelt thank you to everyone who joined us. We can't wait to see you all again next year!

Questions? Comment below or ask in our CLO discord server: https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/7814962429977-How-can-I-join-CLO-Discord- 

---

transcript: Hi everyone, welcome once again to our second User Summit in Madrid. The idea of ​​this event is that you can look around, recognize yourself among you, among the brands. All of us who are here are trying to change the industry and it is not easy. Well, I really thought they were all super interesting. It is my first year here and well, I think it took me like a pleasant surprise. It's been a while, but I remember that I was with a partner that I had, we started to think about how we can help the client to visualize the product that we can offer them. What we did at Happy Poon is to create a 3D department directly, but we also believe that it is very important to pass it on to the patronage team because they see the plan and the physical in five minutes. Now we have the entire internal collection already created from the start and Custom is taking it to a certain part, an external company, and what we want to do is take it all. The most interesting thing for me has been the part of artificial intelligence, because it is something very, very expected of us. Thank you.
markdown_content: ## Overview of the Clo User Summit 2024 in Madrid This section covers the context and purpose of the Clo User Summit 2024 held in Madrid, highlighting the focus on industry transformation, 3D product visualization, and the integration of artificial intelligence in workflows. The Clo User Summit 2024 brought together brands and professionals aiming to innovate and transform the industry. The event emphasized collaboration and sharing experiences to drive change. A key theme was enhancing client engagement by improving product visualization using 3D technology. ## 3D Visualization and Internal Workflow Integration This section details the implementation of 3D visualization in the product development process, including the creation of an internal 3D department and collaboration with external partners for custom collections. At Happy Poon, a dedicated 3D department was established to enable clients to better visualize products. The visualization process is integrated with the patronage team, allowing them to quickly understand the design plans and physical prototypes within minutes. The entire internal collection is now created with this 3D-first approach. Custom collections are partially outsourced to external companies, but there is an ongoing effort to internalize the entire process to maintain consistency and control. ## Emphasis on Artificial Intelligence in Product Development This section highlights the importance and expectations around artificial intelligence (AI) at the summit, reflecting its growing role in the industry. Artificial intelligence was identified as a highly anticipated and crucial element for innovation. Participants expressed strong interest in how AI can enhance and accelerate various stages of product design and development, signaling a shift toward more intelligent, automated workflows within the fashion and product visualization sectors.
